items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: I don't want to criticize, but we were not Guy Lombardo, 'cause those guys are hard-headed, they wouldn't learn.

ctx.x: That's about the time that Guy Lombardo came around. I'm not saying that they're responsible for it, but it was about that time that -- I mean what happened in New York, was -- it never happened before and one would never thing it would happen and well, the boys were thrown out on the street
